## Summary

A brief description of the feature or improvement you'd like.

## Motivation

Why is this needed? What problem does it solve, or what use case does it enable?

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you'd like to see - a new UI component, editor capability, workflow improvement, etc.

## Mockup or example (if applicable)

Attach a sketch, screenshot, or description of the desired UI/UX.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about.

## Additional context

Links, references, or any other context that helps explain the request.
